title: Police justified in shooting man, investigators say
article: City police were justified when they shot dead a man who drove a stolen Jeep towards an officer, investigators said yesterday.
The Special Investigations Unit found that Toronto constables Paul Lentsch and Bob Grewal were legally justified when both opened fire on John Menga, Feb. 1.

"In attempting to escape by negotiating around the police cruiser, Mr. Menga drove the Jeep at Const. Lentsch, placing the officer in a life-threatening situation," the SIU report stated. "Both officers fired at Mr. Menga, striking him several times.
